honest_scope: Two independent browser identities on ONE machine (http://localhost:8150 and http://127.0.0.1:8150 — different origins, so separate non-extractable Ed25519 keys). A recorded observation, not a regenerable receipt: browser keys are random, so keyed seed numbers differ from the CI receipt. The byte-reproducible receipt for the same protocol is receipts/stage-unlock.json (CI re-runs it, including every attack). The two-DEVICE run waits on a second device.
